subtitle: The standards, certifications and programmes data center operators publish holding
body_html:
These are the standards, certifications and programmes that data center operators publish holding. They cover how a facility is run, how its customers' data is protected, how it is designed to stay up, and how much energy it uses. A tier rating from the Uptime Institute or a rating under ANSI/TIA-942 describes the building and its redundancy. An ISO management system certificate describes how the operator runs the site. A SOC report or a CSA STAR entry describes controls a customer can rely on. Each page lists the facilities and operators that publish holding the standard, read from the operators' own compliance pages, and a claim an operator makes for its whole business is shown as operator wide rather than copied onto every site.

Management systems

  • ISO 9001
    The ISO requirements standard for a quality management system, now in its 2026 edition
  • ISO 14001
    The ISO requirements standard for an environmental management system, now in its 2026 edition
  • ISO 50001
    The ISO requirements standard for continually improving energy performance
  • ISO 45001
    The ISO requirements standard for managing workplace health and safety
  • ISO 22301
    The ISO requirements standard for preparing for, responding to and recovering from disruption

Cloud security, privacy and assurance

  • ISO/IEC 27017
    ISO/IEC guidance on information security controls for providing and using cloud services, built on ISO/IEC 27002
  • ISO/IEC 27018
    ISO/IEC guidelines for protecting personal data in public cloud services that process it for customers
  • ISO/IEC 27701
    The ISO/IEC requirements standard for a privacy information management system (PIMS)
  • SOC 1
    An AICPA attestation report on a service organization's controls that affect its customers' financial reporting
  • CSA STAR
    Cloud Security Alliance's cloud assurance programme and public registry
  • Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus
    The UK NCSC's baseline cyber security certification, with an independently tested Plus level
  • TISAX
    The automotive industry's information security assessment and exchange mechanism, run by ENX

Facility design and tiers

  • Uptime Institute Tier Standard and Tier Certification
    Uptime Institute's four-Tier classification and its stage-by-stage facility certification
  • ANSI/TIA-942
    TIA's data center infrastructure standard, rated Rated-1 to Rated-4, certified by TIA-licensed bodies
  • EN 50600 and TSI
    CENELEC's European standard series for data center infrastructure, and TÜViT's TSI certification scheme

Energy and green building

  • EU Code of Conduct for Data Centres (Energy Efficiency)
    The European Commission JRC's voluntary energy efficiency programme for data centers
  • Climate Neutral Data Centre Pact
    A self-regulatory initiative of European data center operators and trade associations to reach climate neutrality by 2030
  • LEED
    USGBC's green building rating for a single building or project

Six security standards in Security and Business Governance also list the data centers that publish holding them: ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, FedRAMP and HITRUST CSF. For the facilities themselves, see Data Centers.
